title: [3.0-dev] delta values reset to 0 when updating historic BG values from Nightscout
body:
For BG values I have xDrip+ performing a local broadcast and upload to Nightscout.
AndroidAPS accepts BG values from xDrip+.
If NSClient is set to "Receive/backfill CGM data", AAPS will first receive the new BG value from xDrip+ - and then receive the same value again from NS - only that receiving the value from NS causes all delta calculations to be reset to 0 and thus the closed loop is effectively and permanently disabled.

comments.body: xdrip doesn't handle timestamps with NS correctly thus records get doubled with slightly different timestamps and delta become zero. it's xdrip issue
Is there an open issue with xDrip where this is tracked?
I'm not sure. It was ever so
